name: Palindrome Partition
description: Given a string s , find the number of ways to split s to substrings such that if there are k substrings ( p 1 , p 2 , p 3 , ..., p k ) in partition, then p i = p k - i + 1 for all i (1 ≤ i ≤ k ) and k is even. Since the number of ways can be large, print it modulo 10 9 + 7 .
input_specification: The only line of input contains a string s (2 ≤ | s | ≤ 10 6 ) of even length consisting of lowercase Latin letters.
output_specification: Print one integer, the number of ways of partitioning the string modulo 10 9 + 7 .
approach_summary: Apply Knapsack and Basic Dynamic Programming paradigm under the Dynamic Programming (DP) framework. Exploit problem invariants to reduce state space and achieve optimal complexity.
